name: get_shipment_status
description: Return the current status, location and hold reason of one consignment by its id (e.g. KF-2481).

name: lookup_order
description: Return the sales order behind a consignment: items, invoice value, consignee and billing address.

name: find_alternate_carriers
description: List carriers that can take a lane within 48 hours, with indicative price per kg.

name: process_refund
description: Issue a refund to the customer on a consignment. Irreversible. Requires refund:write scope.

amount_inr.description: Amount in rupees, max 5000 without human approval

name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the case to an operations lead when a refund exceeds the cap, a hold passes eight hours, or the customer threatens to cancel.

name: get_customer
description: Return a customer profile: name, tier, phone, preferred language and open consignments.

name: send_sms
description: Send an SMS to a customer phone number using an approved template.

name: generate_eway_bill
description: Generate a fresh e-way bill on the GST portal for a consignment and invoice.

name: weather_at_depot
description: Return the current weather and a 24-hour forecast at a named depot.
